replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
How does this work?

What happens if your monuments are destroyed? Do you to to spectate mode?
replies.body_tagged:
How does this work?

replies.author: Loo
replies.body: Basically there's 8 monuments, 2 are red, 2 are blue, 2 are yellow, and 2 are green. What you have to do to win is to destroy one yellow and one green monument. (If you're blue for example), but it has to be a specific yellow and a specific green of the two of each color. The first team to destroy their assigned monuments wins. It's a really confusing map to be honest. I was on blue and the green that we had to destroy was literally on our side so there's no way green could've defended it and I destroyed it within a minute. However, the yellow that we had to destroy was on the other side of the map and it was fairly difficult to get to. It's a great map but it has its flaws.

replies.author: piratewithgun
replies.body:
I played this map too, and maybe they changed it, but the way it works is that each team has to destroy 2 monuments of their own colour. So if i was red for example, I would try to destroy both red mons each of which will be defended by a different team.

The problem with this game though is that there is a much smaller incentive to defend, because you are only preventing one other team from winning. Good fun though :)
